name: quotations
notes: Owns lump-sum quotations, their payment-stage schedule and status history. Does not compute tax or create projects: P1-09 reacts to quotation.accepted. Quotation numbers come from the number series quotation (prefix QUO, H-27); a revision keeps the number and raises its revision, printed as number/revision. estimate_id, lead_id, party_id and location_id are plain references with no foreign keys into other modules. The approval document type is quotation (H-09); the margin floor is the typed setting quotations.margin_floor_percent and is passed to the approval request as context. The client acceptance document is a file of entity type qte_quotation. The scheduler calls expireDue once a day (BR-5).
